title: Methodology of Adapting Large English Language Models for Specific Cultural Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's domain-specific knowledge, cultural comprehension, and values alignment within a Chinese context using the A-Eval benchmark and the CHisafetybench dataset.

Using the CHisafetybench benchmark to assess the model's ability to identify discriminatory content via multiple-choice questions and measuring its refusal rate and harm rate when presented with risky, discrimination-related prompts.
